pages.text: $(thing)Alex's Caves$() hides six huge biomes underground. Each has its own creatures, blocks and hazards. They are rare, so the mod gives you a way to locate them.

The six: $(bold)Magnetic Caves$(), $(bold)Primordial Caves$() (dinosaurs), $(bold)Toxic Caves$() (acid and uranium), $(bold)Abyssal Chasm$() (a deep water trench), $(bold)Forlorn Hollows$() and $(bold)Candy Cavity$().

pages.title: Spelunkery Table
pages.text: Where Cave Tablets are studied. Place a tablet in the slot to begin research.

pages.title: Cave Biome Map
pages.text: A map pointing to the nearest cave biome of a type. If none is near, travel far away and try again.

Toxic Caves are the Create-connected one. Acid and Purple Soda are marked in Create's own data as $(thing)bottomless$() fluids, like water and lava, so a hose pulley can draw them without running dry. See $(l:create_basics/fluids)Fluids$(/l).

pages.title: Uranium Rod
pages.text: Alex's Caves has its own uranium and a Nuclear Furnace. It is separate content from Create Nuclear, so check JEI before mixing them.

Magnetic Caves add Magnetic Levitation Rail and Neodymium nodes. The Abyssal Chasm links to the ocean: the mod also adds an item called a Submarine, if you want a smaller craft than a $(l:ocean/submarines)Deep Seas$(/l) build.

pages.title: Submarine
pages.text: Alex's Caves' own small submarine, separate from Deep Seas.
Alex's Caves sulfur dust is not its own item here. Its recipes (Slam, Spelunkie, Polymer Plate, gunpowder) use TFMG's sulfur dust, and leftover Alex's dust converts 1:1 in a crafting grid.
